 Outlook Justice Hill 
 Justice Hill vs LAC at home — committee option in a low-scoring matchup 
 Healthy and working as a committee back behind Derrick Henry, Hill enters Monday night with momentum after breaking a 65-yard touchdown in his last outing. With Lamar Jackson sidelined on injured reserve and Jacoby Brissett under center, Baltimore draws a winless Chargers squad as slight home favorites in what projects to be a sluggish, low-scoring affair.
 Recent usage shows roughly six carries and three to four catches per game over his past two appearances, pushing his roster rate up to 23% and start rate to 10%. Our weekly projection lands near 8.8 PPR points on around four carries, three receptions, and 40 total yards, keeping him best viewed as a deep-league PPR flex play rather than a trusted lineup staple.

 Outlook Konata Mumpfield 
 Konata Mumpfield at ARI — expanded role in low-scoring matchup 
 Healthy and starting in the slot, Mumpfield steps into a larger passing-game role on the road against Arizona with Puka Nacua sidelined on injured reserve. After seeing limited volume in his last two games, he now projects as one of Matthew Stafford's primary wideouts alongside Tutu Atwell in a thinned receiver room.
 Fantasy managers have aggressively added Mumpfield on waivers, pushing his rostership near 29 percent while start rates remain modest. Our weekly projection lands near 9 PPR points on roughly 6 targets and 38 receiving yards, making him a viable deep-league play. However, a projected low-scoring environment and Los Angeles operating as heavy road favorites could limit overall passing volume.
